blockers.title: Storage adjudication trusts incomplete and forged evidence
blockers.evidence: The PASS path validates selected scalar fields but has no exact schemas for root-cache snapshots, retained arms, output/cache identities, checkpoint receipts, observer reports, or source/job/postflight bindings. Bare-string root-cache records, a forged retained G0 string, and a checkpoint record containing only paths plus asserted booleans passed.
blockers.required_correction: Define and enforce complete exact evidence schemas. Authenticate cache/output/checkpoint path, mount ID/device, inode, type, mode, owner, link count, size/allocation/timestamps and stable digest; bind checkpoint state/logit digests to rank reports, source, job and postflight. Retained-arm records must authenticate every retained out/cache/checkpoint and fail on missing or extra fields.

blockers.title: Cache snapshot and fresh-path guards are not anchored or race complete
blockers.evidence: snapshot_tree opens the full path with O_NOFOLLOW only on the final component, so an ancestor symlink was accepted. It records nested-directory metadata before recursion but never revalidates nested membership/metadata afterward; a late nested file was omitted without error. validate_initial_absence is a sequence of lexical lstat calls with no stable dirfd chain or atomic creation boundary.
blockers.required_correction: Walk every component through pinned dirfds with O_NOFOLLOW, mount/device and name-to-inode checks. Revalidate exact membership and metadata bottom-up and re-seal the complete chain after traversal. Bind absence directly to O_EXCL creation in the later finalizer and test ancestor swaps, nested late writes, mount replacement and final-name creation at every boundary.

blockers.title: Checkpoint guard accepts unsafe mode and ancestor substitution
blockers.evidence: A world-writable 0666 checkpoint passed because no accepted mode is enforced. The guard lstat-checks ancestors lexically and then opens the complete parent path; swapping the out directory in between caused a replacement checkpoint to be accepted while the original survived elsewhere. The returned guard record also does not directly match the storage adjudicator's mount_device/regular schema.
blockers.required_correction: Use a pinned no-follow dirfd chain from authenticated /dev/shm through the exact arm/out path, enforce exact allowed mode and mount ID/device on every component, and bind the final name/inode before and after all validation. Use one exact checkpoint receipt schema consumed directly by adjudication without synthesized trust fields.

blockers.title: Watcher and root-capacity enforcement can pass without required evidence or reservation
blockers.evidence: run_watcher accepts an empty sample list as PASS and carries no cadence/timestamp/completeness proof. validate_resources accepts G0 root_free_bytes=7247757312, although the proposal requires current free minus all remaining stage/log allowances to remain at least that breaker; with three source and log allowances the corresponding value is 7849426944. No inode-floor evidence is enforced.
blockers.required_correction: Require a bounded nonempty, ordered watcher series covering launch through quiescence with authenticated cadence and terminal postflight. Enforce the proposal's remaining-stage/log reservation formula before each stage and dispatch, plus exact root/tmpfs inode gates, hard/operational floors and full per-arm combined allocation accounting.

blockers.title: Legacy regression suite is not migration-aware
blockers.evidence: The Torch-backed legacy gate suite has 55 passes and five failures tied to deliberately consumed trn21 observer/manifest/finalization identities. This does not show numeric drift, but leaves no all-green regression command that distinguishes intended identity rejection from accidental legacy scientific breakage.
blockers.required_correction: Add an explicit migration-aware regression layer that preserves and runs all legacy science/parser/ownership tests while asserting old trn21 observer execution is rejected and the fresh trn22 adapter is accepted.

authorization_decision.required_next_step: Correct T22-B1 through T22-B5 and obtain a fresh independent package review.
